title: Digital education & employment
summary: Bridging the digital divide with technology-driven learning, career guidance, and job-ready training for underserved youth.
bodyMarkdown:
## What we deliver

- Digital literacy from fundamentals to workplace tools
- Interview practice and resume support
- Employer-aligned projects and assessments

## Outcomes

Youth leave with portfolios and confidence to pursue formal jobs, apprenticeships, or further study.
